technical.summary: Mixed technicals with intermediate-term bullish structure (supertrend, Ichimoku) offset by weak momentum (RSI 14 falling, MACD negative, price below key EMAs), creating low-probability swing entry without confirmed reversal signals.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (234.4) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 58 days adds event risk but is not imminent; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational CSCO.
